camel_example: aliyun agentidentity SetSpecificIdentityProvider --region cn-hangzhou --SSOStatus Enabled --IDPMetadata '{"corpId":"dingxxxxxxxxxx","appKey":"dingxxxxxxxxxx","appSecret":"your_app_secret","encryptKey":"your_encrypt_key","verificationToken":"your_verification_token","syncCallbackStatus":"Enabled"}' --IdentityProviderType DingTalk --UserPoolName 'my-agent-userpool' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Configures the SSO settings for a specified type of identity provider in a user pool
description_zh: 配置用户池下指定类型身份提供商的 SSO 设置
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity set-specific-identity-provider --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --identity-provider-type DingTalk --sso-status Enabled --id-p-metadata '{"corpId":"dingxxxxxxxxxx","appKey":"dingxxxxxxxxxx","appSecret":"your_app_secret","encryptKey":"your_encrypt_key","verificationToken":"your_verification_token","syncCallbackStatus":"Enabled"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetSpecificIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity provider. Currently, only DingTalk is supported
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供商类型。当前仅支持 DingTalk
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

parameters.help_en:
The SSO enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
SSO 启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：未启用
parameters.name: sso_status

parameters.help_en: The IdP metadata. When the type is DingTalk, the value is in JSON format and includes fields such as corpId, appKey, appSecret, encryptKey, verificationToken, and syncCallbackStatus
parameters.help_zh: IDP 元数据。DingTalk 类型时为 JSON 格式，包含 corpId、appKey、appSecret、encryptKey、verificationToken、syncCallbackStatus 等字段
parameters.name: id_p_metadata

SpecificIdentityProviderConfiguration.description_en: The configuration information of the configured identity provider
SpecificIdentityProviderConfiguration.description_zh: 配置后的身份提供商配置信息

IdentityProviderType.description_en: The type of the identity provider
